mapper.select: SELECT s.sid, s.company_name, s.ticker, s.sector, sd.current_price, ROUND((sd.current_price - sd.open_price) / sd.open_price * 100, 2) AS change_rate, (sd.current_price - sd.open_price) AS change_price FROM stock s JOIN stock_detail sd ON s.sid = sd.sid WHERE sd.trade_date = ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_detail WHERE sid = s.sid ) ORDER BY s.company_name

SELECT s.sid, s.company_name, s.ticker, s.description, s.sector, s.market, s.market_cap, s.foreign_ownership_pct, s.per, s.eps, s.pbr, s.bps, sd.current_price, sd.open_price, sd.high_price, sd.low_price, sd.prev_close_price, sd.volume, sd.trading_value, sd.w52_high_price, sd.w52_low_price, sd.trade_date, ROUND((sd.current_price - sd.prev_close_price) / sd.prev_close_price * 100, 2) AS change_rate, (sd.current_price - sd.prev_close_price) AS change_price FROM stock s JOIN stock_detail sd ON s.sid = sd.sid WHERE s.ticker = #{ticker} AND sd.trade_date = ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_detail WHERE sid = s.sid )

SELECT MAX(d.trade_date) AS `date`, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(d.open_price ORDER BY d.trade_date ASC), ',', 1) AS SIGNED) AS `open`, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(d.close_p ORDER BY d.trade_date ASC), ',', -1) AS SIGNED) AS `close`, CAST(MAX(d.high_price) AS SIGNED) AS `high`, CAST(MIN(d.low_price) AS SIGNED) AS `low` FROM ( SELECT sd.trade_date, sd.open_price, COALESCE(sd.close_price, sd.current_price) AS close_p, sd.high_price, sd.low_price FROM stock_detail sd JOIN stock s ON s.sid = sd.sid WHERE s.ticker = #{ticker} ORDER BY sd.trade_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) d GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.trade_date, #{groupFormat}) ORDER BY `date` ASC
